experience.summary: Full lifecycle software engineering across backend systems, REST APIs, enterprise ERP modules, multi-provider payment integrations, AI document OCR, and cloud infrastructure on AWS EC2.
experience.impact: Published Odoo App Store modules achieving 185+ sales; built and deployed real-time WebSocket systems, Generative AI OCR tools, and production AWS infrastructure for global clients.
highlights: API Development: Developed and maintained REST APIs for mobile and web clients across Mobikul, Mobikul POS, Mobikul Multivendor, Mobikul Attendance, and Delivery Boy apps (products, orders, delivery, inventory, notifications); delivered multiple client projects with customizations such as notification sounds, advanced search, and customer-based pricelists.

Odoo App Store: Built and published Odoo modules in Python (models, APIs, web views): Project Gantt Native (68+ sales), Mobikul (54+ sales), Delivery Boy (37+ sales), AI Business Card Reader (12+ sales), ZPL Label Designer (7+ sales), and Manufacturing Alternate Product (7+ sales).

AI & OCR: Developing Odoo AI OCR Mobile App, an AI-powered OCR module that scans invoices, vendor bills, expenses, and business documents using Generative AI to automate enterprise document processing.

Websites & Real-Time Engine: Created a real estate auction website with WebSocket-based real-time bidding, plus additional website modules and SEO redirects to optimize client platforms; integrated Mobikul and Delivery Boy APIs into mobile apps.

E-Commerce & Large-Scale Migration: Led Odoo ERP e-commerce and sales projects, including migrating CS-Cart websites for multiple clients to Odoo as the end-to-end developer; migrated a client's Mobikul server and historical data from Odoo 16 to 19.

Payment Integrations: Integrated Stripe Terminal, Linkly, and Tyro payment services with Odoo Invoicing (API communication, transaction and error handling, payment-status synchronization), plus payment providers including Stripe and Worldpay.

Manufacturing & Hardware: Built Manufacturing Gantt Native, the Manufacturing Alternate Product module (alternate products on manufacturing orders), and a customizable ZPL label designer with dynamic product data, barcode/QR generation, label previews, and printer-ready ZPL output.

Cloud Deployment & AWS: Deployed Odoo end to end on clients' AWS EC2 instances, including Odoo configuration, Nginx configuration (sites-available and sites-enabled), systemd service files, and server performance optimization.

Integrations & Authentication: Implemented OTP authentication for login and signup, plus Nafath and OTP/WhatsApp verification, adapting backend validation to client-specific requirements; delivered API customizations for a separate client mobile app using Odoo's JSON-2 API.

Production Support & Maintenance: Resolved production issues across multiple client instances and Odoo versions, including API validation, database concurrency, authentication, third-party integrations, and Odoo.sh deployment/build failures.

projects.title: E-Commerce Order Management Platform
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput Microservice Architecture with FastAPI & Celery
projects.description: A scalable backend order processing and inventory management platform designed for high-concurrency e-commerce operations with asynchronous queues and distributed workers.
projects.problem: Handling burst order traffic, inventory race conditions, and heavy checkout flows requires decoupled background processing, atomic database transactions, and aggressive caching.
projects.impact: Engineered sub-50ms API response times with Redis caching, eliminated duplicate order submissions, and ensured zero-downtime task execution via Celery workers.
highlights: Designed REST APIs for authentication, products, inventory, cart, and orders, with JWT authentication and role-based access control (RBAC).
Added Redis caching, API rate limiting, and asynchronous order processing with Celery task queues.
Modeled an indexed PostgreSQL schema with robust transaction handling to guarantee inventory consistency.
Containerized services with Docker Compose; added Pytest unit/integration test suites and an automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

projects.title: Distributed Notification Platform
projects.subtitle: Asynchronous Multi-Worker Messaging Architecture
projects.description: An enterprise-grade notification platform supporting scheduled alerts, user notification preferences, rate limiting, and idempotent event processing across multiple worker nodes.
projects.problem: Large-scale user notification dispatch often suffers from worker failures, duplicate messages, and queue congestion during peak campaign broadcasts.
projects.impact: Achieved zero duplicate deliveries through idempotent task execution, graceful retry handling with exponential backoff, and documented OpenAPI interface.
highlights: Built an asynchronous notification-processing architecture with retry and failure handling for distributed workers, and idempotent processing to prevent duplicate notifications.
Added scheduled notifications, granular user notification preferences, dynamic rate limiting, and Redis-backed task queues.
Documented all API endpoints and schemas using OpenAPI (Swagger) specifications for seamless client integration.

projects.title: Odoo AI OCR Mobile App & Doc Engine
projects.subtitle: Generative AI Document Scanner for Enterprise Accounting
projects.description: An AI-powered OCR module that scans invoices, vendor bills, expense receipts, and business documents using Generative AI to automate bookkeeping inside Odoo.
projects.problem: Manual entry of supplier invoices, line items, and tax numbers is error-prone, labor-intensive, and introduces accounting delays.
projects.impact: Automates document ingestion directly into Odoo Invoicing with high extraction precision, structured entity parsing, and validation against existing vendors.
highlights: Engineered Generative AI extraction pipeline to parse unstructured receipt and invoice PDFs/images into validated structured JSON.
Integrated OCR payloads into Odoo accounting workflows for automated draft bill creation and vendor matching.
Architected mobile client endpoints for immediate scan, preview, and confirmation by field teams.

projects.title: Real-Time Auction & Real Estate Bidding Engine
projects.subtitle: WebSocket-Based Synchronized Bidding Platform
projects.description: A high-performance real estate auction platform featuring WebSocket-powered live bidding, synchronized bid state across all active bidders, and comprehensive SEO optimization.
projects.problem: Auction platforms need sub-second bid propagation and guaranteed chronological ordering so bidders experience zero latency discrepancies.
projects.impact: Delivered instantaneous live bidding updates, zero page refreshes during competitive bidding wars, and optimized search ranking with automated redirects.
highlights: Architected real-time WebSocket communication layer for instantaneous bid broadcast and timer synchronization.
Developed custom Odoo website modules, SEO redirects, and schema markup to maximize search visibility.
Built resilient APIs connecting web client and mobile bidding applications.
